title: Technician - B. Add inspection to a work order line
preconds: Logged in as Technician. Tech View. Per SV-8095 AC4, View Mode is NOT a gate for inspections. A work order with at least one line exists.
steps:
1. Log in.
  2. Open a work order and locate a line.
  3. Open the three-dot menu on the line.
  4. Select Add Inspection and choose a template.
  5. Repeat on an existing/approved line.
expected:
Step 3: The three-dot menu shows Add Inspection.
Step 4: The inspection is added and "Inspection added to line." is shown.
Step 5: Adding is ALSO allowed on an existing/approved line. Per SV-8095 AC4, View Mode is not a gate - the read-only-after-approval rule applies to the line's own fields, not attached inspections. Technician has WOL Create and Edit.
